subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the focused same-session-collision fix while leaving reattach-first recovery to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and proven, but it deliberately preserves a rare duplicate-execution behavior that affects model/tool side effects and possible `--deliver` sends.

options.title: Land focused fix first
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style fresh-session fallback boundary here, then evaluate reattach-first recovery separately in the linked follow-up issue.

options.title: Expand into reattach-first before merge
options.body: Ask the author to extend this PR so accepted disconnects try to recover the original gateway run before starting an embedded fallback.

options.title: Pause until fallback policy is decided
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose whether accepted disconnects should ever recook locally after the gateway accepts a run.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix first
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style fresh-session fallback boundary here, then evaluate reattach-first recovery separately in the linked follow-up issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and has the heaviest history on the gateway-backed agent CLI path where the product fallback policy lives.
